resources.string: Install Afnon from this phone in a few minutes, no computer needed. First, four steps on the TV with its remote.
Press OK on it 7 times, until the TV says you are now a developer.
Turn on USB debugging (some TVs say ADB or Network debugging). If you see Wireless debugging, turn it on too.
Keep the TV and this phone on the same Wi-Fi network.
Searching your Wi-Fi. Tap your TV when it appears.
• Check that debugging is on (step 3).\n• Make sure both are on the same Wi-Fi.\n• Some routers hide devices from each other: type the TV’s address instead.
Find it on the TV in Settings › Network & Internet › your Wi-Fi. Wireless debugging also shows “IP address & Port”: type both, like 192.168.1.50:41234. With only the address, every port is checked.
This phone isn’t on Wi-Fi. Connect to the same network as the TV, then try again.
Looking for an open debugging port on %1$s. This takes about 15 seconds.
Wireless debugging needs a one-time code from the TV.
Type the six-digit code it shows
Waiting for the pairing dialog on the TV…
Pairing port (after the colon on the TV)
Afnon %1$s · keep this screen open. It takes a minute or two.
Keep this screen open. It takes a minute or two.
Another copy of Afnon is on the TV
It was signed with a different key, so it can’t be updated in place. Removing it also removes its settings (city, favourites, adhan choices). Remove it and install the latest?
Remote buttons and the call to prayer
Starts by itself after a restart
Quran Radio level bars and sleep timer
Afnon %1$s is installed and set up. Pick up the remote.
Afnon is installed and set up. Pick up the remote.
Afnon is on the TV, but a step marked in red didn’t finish. Run the installer again to retry it.
You can turn off USB debugging and Wireless debugging on the TV now. To update Afnon later, turn debugging back on and open this app again.
The TV didn’t allow this phone. Try again and choose Allow on the TV.
No debugging port is open on %1$s.
Pairing didn’t work (%1$s). Open the pairing dialog on the TV again; it shows a new code each time.
Afnon needs Android 8 or later on the TV.
• The TV is on and awake.\n• Debugging is on in Developer options.\n• The TV and this phone are on the same Wi-Fi.
